SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Take care of yourself first, Kyuri!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 请您先顾好自己吧方护士！！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 久梨小姐，請你先顧好自己！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: まずは自分のことを心配してください、ギュリさん！！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Urus diri sendiri dulu dong Gyuri!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اول از همه مراقب خودت باش، کیوری!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Are you worried about me even in this situation?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 這種時候還在擔心我嗎？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: こんな状況でも、まだ俺の心配ですか？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Di situasi kayak gini pun masih mikirin aku?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Mesmo nessa situação, ainda tá preocupada comigo?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿Incluso en esta situación está preocupándose por mí?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: حتی تو این شرایط هم نگران منی؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I said take care of yourself first!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我说让你先照顾好自己！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 我說過叫你要先照顧好自己
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ギュリさんの方を先に気にしてください
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Tô dizendo pra se preocupar com você.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Le digo que se preocupe por usted.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아까 그 이상한 간호사에, 어? 감기만 지금 몇 주째예요!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: That weird nurse earlier, huh? You've had this cold for weeks now!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 除了霸凌你的同事，还有你的感冒，都拖了几周了！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 剛才那個奇怪的護士，還有，你的感冒都拖多久了，嗯？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あの変な看護師のこともあるし、風邪だって何週間も続いてるじゃないですか！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Itu perawat aneh tadi tuh terus kamu udah pilek berapa minggu sekarang?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Aquela enfermeira de antes, hein? E ainda por cima tá resfriada há semanas!
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Esa enfermera de antes, ¿eh? ¡Y encima lleva semanas resfriada!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اون پرستار عجیب و غریب قبلی، ها؟ تو الان چند هفته‌ست که این سرماخوردگی رو داری!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: What~ Are you actually worried about me now, Yoo-man?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 什么嘛~你是在担心我吗？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 什麼嗎～你現在是在擔心我嗎？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: え〜、今、私のこと心配してくれてるんですか？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Apa sih~ kamu lagi khawatir sama aku, ya?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: O quê~? Tá se preocupando comigo, é isso?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: چی~ الان واقعاً نگران منی، یو-مان؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아니, 규리 씨 그게 포인트가 아니잖아요!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Oh, Kyuri, that's not the point!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 哎呦久梨，这重点不在这里吧！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 不是，久梨小姐，那不是重點
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: いや、ギュリさん今そういうことじゃないくて！
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não é esse o ponto, Gyuri.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Ese no es el punto, Gyuri.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I'm telling you to take care of your health too.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 你也要多关心自己的健康啊
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你也要多關心自己的健康啊！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: キュリさんもちゃんと体調管理してくださいよ
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku cuma bilang, tolong jaga kesehatan juga.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Só tô dizendo pra você cuidar da sua saúde também.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Solo digo que también cuide su salud.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: به شما هم میگم که مراقب سلامتیتون باشید.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 유만 씨가 걱정해주니까 전 너무 좋은데요?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: It makes me feel so good that you're worried about me, Yoo-man?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 能被你挂在心上，感觉还挺好的呢
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 能被你擔心，我卻感到開心呢
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ユマンさんが心配してくれると、なんか嬉しいんですよ？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kalau Yuman peduli gini rasanya seneng banget tahu nggak?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: adoro quando você se preocupa comigo.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: me encanta que se preocupe por mí.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اینکه نگران من هستی، حس خیلی خوبی بهم میده، یو-مان؟
